trades.notes: Pre-market plan: Coming into the market today i was looking at longs, why? Because overnight we had made a low and found price trading back inside fair value, at the open we already had pushed higher above poc and i thought if we get a retest lower ill try longs to higher.   Profile looked like this at 9 so marked my key levels and decided to do the 786 today because of the imbalances closer to the low. To be honest i was thinking i probably missed the trade when we moved down first and hit 0.705 + val (i planned originally to take longs there but something was off today)...  later on i got the entry at 30195 level (wanted 199 but i took a mean of 2 imbalances and said why not here to myself)   -- Price 3 points from my stoploss before moving up again, i did feel some emotions today, not gonna lie, so my breakeven got moved after we reclaimed the entry again with some speed. Then it went fast to my tp.   My original target would have been vah but because of consistency im doing only 3RR trades to begin with.   Overall, very happy with my performance today, i stuck to taking the trade even after it already moved from 705.
